QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Lavi the Thinker
QuestInfo.0: Talk to the adventurer #bValerie#k you met in #bForest: Crossroad#k.
QuestInfo.1: You decide to investigate Stone Colossus with Valerie, the adventurer that you met in Forest: Crossroad. To start, head to the #bExplorer Base#k and meet #bLavi#k.
QuestInfo.2: Lavi, the lead explorer, seems to be deep in thought.

0.0: You came to investigate Stone Colossus? That's great! Since we seem to have the same goal, why don't we #binvestigate together#k? I don't know about others, but if the Ace of the Alliance helps, I can finish this mission quickly!

yes.0: Wow! Thank you very much! Then let's head to the #bExplorer Base#k and see the Halflingers that discovered Stone Colossus. I heard a Halflinger named #bLavi#k is leading the exploration team and might have valuable information.

no.0: Why would you refuse?! Do you hate me? Say it isn't so!

1.0: There's only so much we can do with burnt up wood and old supplies. Maybe this camp is too close to the #rStone Colossus#k... No. I can't move it. I just need to figure out some way to make it work...

yes.0: Who are you two? I'm a little busy here.

npc.0: Then shall we go to the #bExplorer Base#k where the Halflingers that discovered Stone Colossus are? We might get information if we talk to the Halflinger called #bLavi#k!
